cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Say You’re Sorry
cards.instruction: Maneuver someone into apologizing without naming the offense.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your parents arrive in ten minutes. I'd like to be able to smile at you. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd sorted this out by text.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. You sent a thumbs-up. I couldn't hear any remorse.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're right here. Could you give the sad face a sentence beginning with 'I'?
